direction: A - strong-base pure self-evolution with no teacher (user direction 2026-08-18)
program_target: Measure whether OpenEvo can improve WebShop score, speed, or execution quality, then compare the stabilized route with a separately frozen SEED baseline.
scientific_question: Does raising the base-model scale from Qwen2.5-3B to Qwen2.5-7B open the self-evolution capability gate (at least two train task identities and eight qualified self-generated episodes) that 3B failed, on the SAME frozen H1.29 task manifest?
hypothesis: H1.27 showed Qwen2.5-7B and Granite-3.3-2B each produced qualified positives where Qwen2.5-3B produced zero. If capability is the bottleneck, then on the identical frozen H1.29 train tasks, seeds, and contracts, Qwen2.5-7B should yield at least two task identities and eight qualified self-generated episodes, opening the gate H1.29 could not.
independent_variable: base-model scale (Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct -> Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct); every other variable is frozen task-matched to H1.29

route_decision.current_evidence: H1.29 closed self-evolution-not-supported for Qwen2.5-3B (capability gate produced positives but the held-out transfer stayed 0.0; and at the 3B scale the harvest gate is the binding constraint). H1.27 showed a one-scale-up base (7B) crosses the qualified-positive threshold that 3B could not.
route_decision.selected_route: strong-base self-evolution (direction A): repeat the exact H1.29 self-evolution route with the base model scaled 3B -> 7B and nothing else changed
route_decision.fallback_route: If Qwen2.5-7B ALSO fails the capability gate on the same tasks, capability at this scale is not the binding constraint; stop this route and either register route B (teacher bootstrap with a hashed teacher manifest and privileged-context boundary) or a matched SEED contract. Do not silently substitute another model or an online endpoint.
route_decision.capability_gate: Proceed to training only if at least two train task identities yield qualified self-generated episodes and at least eight qualified episodes in total.

arms.SELF-EVOLUTION: one rank-4 OpenEvo SD-LoRA adapter trained only on qualified Qwen2.5-7B self-generated success episodes from the train split

train_panel.selection_rule: reuse the frozen H1.29 task manifest verbatim (NOT a fresh selection) so the 7B-versus-3B comparison is task-matched; task description text is re-derived from the seed root and cross-checked against the frozen record sha256
train_panel.frozen_source_manifest_note: sha256 of the committed H1.29 public-manifest-record file, the artifact the H1.36 builder loads and verifies. The record anchors the original H1.29 server-side run manifest via its server_file_sha256 (a7c3fc7a, see h1_29_manifest_sha256 below) and the canonical content hash e42188b1; the two manifest artifacts were previously conflated into one hash constant.
train_panel.frozen_source_manifest_errata: Forensics on 2026-08-18 found the frozen record's stored hash for evaluation goal 1082 is a corrupt 63-char value (25ab31a4faf...); the authoritative execution-time server manifest (server_file_sha256 a7c3fc7a) and the live seed root both give 25ab4caf4faf.... The frozen record file is left byte-identical (its integrity anchors still verify); the builder corrects only this one expected hash via H129_RECORD_ERRATA and keeps the gate fail-closed for all 16 tasks. See docs/evidence/remote-runs/2026-08-16/h1.29/manifests/h1.29-task-manifest-v1-errata-goal-1082.md.
train_panel.qualification: identity_ok and trace_complete and no parser/fallback/error and final_task_score > 0

comparison_to_h1_29.design: identical task manifest, rollout seeds, prompt/action contracts, and training hyperparameters; only the base model differs, yielding a paired Qwen2.5-7B versus Qwen2.5-3B capability comparison on the same tasks
comparison_to_h1_29.h1_29_baseline: Qwen2.5-3B self-evolution closed negative (self-evolution-not-supported); H1.36 tests whether scaling the base reverses the harvest-gate outcome

frozen_variables.model_revision_kind: local-content-pin (sha256 over config.json + model.safetensors.index.json + tokenizer_config.json); the model is a pinned read-only local directory, not an HF hub snapshot, so the content pin replaces an HF commit hash
frozen_variables.python_runtime_fingerprint_note: sha256 of the sorted pip freeze of the shared phase-g-live-20260814 env. H1.29 used d7220829; the env was later changed by the deliberate doctor-openevo-327d2f5-20260817 dependency repair (auxiliary serving/async/lightgbm packages only). torch 2.12.1, transformers 4.51.1, peft 0.15.2, accelerate 1.10.1, numpy 1.26.4, safetensors 0.5.3 verified byte-identical to the H1.29 era, so the drift carries no scientific confound; H1.36 pins the current doctor-passed state rather than rebuilding.

primary: qualified self-generated train episodes by task identity (the capability gate)

positive_rule: The capability gate passes at 7B (where 3B failed), and SELF-EVOLUTION has a positive aggregate paired score delta over BASE plus positive mean score on at least two complete task identities; this remains a route result and does not open Q3 without independent confirmation.
negative_rule: If the capability gate still fails at 7B, classify self-evolution as capability-insensitive at this scale and stop; if training succeeds but the held-out paired delta is non-positive or task-local, retain the negative result and do not sweep rank/LR/epoch/prompt.
invalid_rule: Exclude runtime/parser/identity failures from scientific denominators; repair only provenance/runtime faults before a fresh preregistered group.
contamination_rules: train and evaluation task identities are disjoint (inherited from the frozen H1.29 split)
evaluation outcomes and traces never enter the self-generated dataset
only Qwen2.5-7B outputs from train tasks may enter the self-generated dataset; H1.29 3B trajectories never enter it
no teacher, oracle, memory, retrieval, prompt change, or action post-processing during evaluation
one formal adapter training run and no retry after valid completion
the task manifest is reused frozen from H1.29, not freshly selected, to preserve task-matched comparability

resource_budget.parallel_policy: eight UUID-bound sibling containers for train harvest and each evaluation wave; no duplicate occupancy
resource_budget.staged_launch: harvest stage runs the harvest wave and the fail-closed capability gate first; the train and evaluation stages run only after the gate is observed open

tracking.offline_fallback: only after exact online initialization/upload failure is captured with error and spool hash

claim_boundary: H1.36 can establish only whether base-model scale opens the self-evolution capability gate and, if so, a bounded fresh-task route result. It cannot claim Q3, H2, ordinary-LoRA superiority, retention, transfer, SEED superiority, or GPT/OPSD equivalence. The SEED win target belongs to a later matched comparison.
next_gate: CPU tests and the manifest/materializer audit must pass before formal task consumption is enabled; the harvest capability gate is observed before any training or evaluation cells run.
